name: xyo-skills
description: XYO and XL1 agent skills for building dApps on the XL1 blockchain. Covers XYO primitives, XL1 chain operations, scaffold tooling, testing, and prescriptive design patterns. Requires companion ariestools-skills for xy-development and xy-toolchain.
longDescription: A layered skill stack for building XL1 dApps and XYO protocol integrations, including scaffold tooling, design patterns, chain knowledge, XYO primitives, and XL1 testing. Install ariestools-skills alongside this pack for TypeScript toolchain and development workflow standards.
